observations: Photo 0: Blue PS4 Slim console, 'Days of Play' limited edition design (triangle/circle/square/cross icons), still wrapped in clear plastic film, sitting on a chair.
Photo 1: Same console next to a camouflage-blue DualShock 4 controller, plastic wrap still on console.
Photo 2: Close-up of the console corner and controller, confirming PlayStation logo and plastic wrap; only one controller visible.
No photo shows the rear/side ports (HDMI, power, USB), no photo shows a receipt, no photo shows any game discs or a game library screen, no photo shows the console powered on.

identity.kind: PS4 Slim console (Days of Play special edition color)

claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show the distinctive blue Days of Play design and PlayStation logo

claims.claim: 10 latest games including FIFA and PES 2027
claims.evidence: no game discs, library screen, or menu shown in any photo

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: plastic wrap is visible but this does not prove internal condition or that it has not been opened
no power-on test, no video, no port close-up in any photo
only one controller is visible in photo 1 and photo 2; no second pad shown

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults
risks.proof: A video clip showing the console powering on, reaching the home screen, and running a game
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / worst-case functional console

risks.risk: Only one controller may actually be included despite 'pads' (plural) claim
risks.proof: A photo showing two controllers together with the console

risks.risk: Claimed 10 games including FIFA/PES may not be installed or may be pirated/hacked copies
risks.proof: A photo of the PS4 game library menu showing installed titles
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, no games credited

risks.risk: Ports (HDMI/USB/power) could be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear port panel, ideally with cables attached
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified port condition, worst case

risks.risk: UK receipt claim cannot be checked, console could be a different region/grey import
risks.proof: A clear photo of the receipt with matching serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverifiable provenance, no premium for 'UK used' claim

proof_requests: A video of the console powering on and loading a game, showing the home screen
A clear photo of the rear port panel
A photo of both controllers together with the console
A photo of the installed game library screen showing the 10 games
A photo of the UK receipt with legible details
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS4 Slim Days of Play console, but all functional and bundle claims (games, both pads, ports, no overheating, receipt) are unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as a single-pad, unproven-working PS4 console.
